verdicts.note: Checks 1-3 cover birth date mismatch, inactive line, and requesting the same device model, resulting in no action/refusal.
If checks 1-3 pass and line is on credit hold, opens a credit review for the line.
The policy requires confirming the surname of the account holder against the account, and making no change/refusing if it does not match or cannot be provided.
The policy requires the account to be active and explicitly notes deferrals cannot be granted on a closed account.
The policy states a bill can be deferred once, and if it has already been deferred, to decline the request.
The policy states a deferral may be at most 14 days, and requests for more are declined.
The policy states a bill in dispute cannot be deferred through this channel.
The policy requires confirming the member's identity via date of birth matching the file before any change, refusing/making no change if it doesn't match or cannot be given.
The policy explicitly requires active member status, declining appeals for inactive members.
The policy states only denied claims can be appealed, and paid, pending, or closed claims cannot.
The policy requires the appeal to be requested within 180 days of the service date, declining if more than 180 days have passed.
The policy specifies each claim may be appealed once, declining if the appeal count is 1 or higher.
The policy requires the caller's stated date of birth to match the profile before any change, refusing otherwise.
The policy specifies the booking must be ticketed, can be changed at most twice, and is declined if it has already been changed twice (change_count >= 2).
The policy specifies opening a review request with reason group_booking for bookings of nine or more passengers.
The policy states the guest must be checked in, and confirmed/checked out/cancelled cannot be extended.
The policy specifies a reservation can be extended at most twice and to decline if it already shows two extensions.
The policy specifies each extension can add at most 3 nights and requests for more are declined.
The policy specifies the new checkout date must be no later than the next arrival date for that room, declining if it would be later.
Matches customer.account_status == 'blacklisted' -> refuse.
Matches rental.status != 'open' -> refuse.
Matches req.days < 1 or req.days > 14 -> refuse.
Matches customer.balance_due > 200 -> refuse.
Matches rental.extensions_count >= 2 -> refuse.
Matches vehicle.next_booking_start != None and add_days(rental.return_date, req.days) >= vehicle.next_booking_start -> review.
The policy requires the student's status to be enrolled, refusing if not.
The policy specifies seats taken must be less than capacity (seats_taken < capacity), refusing if full, matching seats_taken >= capacity.
The policy requires the caller's stated plate to match the plate on the permit, refusing/making no change if it does not match or is not provided.
The policy requires the permit to be active, stating suspended or cancelled permits cannot be renewed.
The policy requires the holder to have no unpaid parking fines, refusing if any amount is owed.
The policy limits renewals to at most 12 months (requests for more are declined) and permits at most four total renewals (cannot be renewed once it has been renewed four times).
Checks that the membership is active, declining if frozen/cancelled.
Declines if balance due is more than 0.00.
Declines if started fewer than 30 days before today.
Declines requests outside the range 1 to 30 days.
Declines if freeze days used plus requested days exceeds 60.
Opens an approval request with reason 'medical_note' for medical reasons instead of freezing directly.
Matches pt.status != 'active' (or suspended) and req.pickup_by == 'other_person' leading to refusal.
Refills left <= 0 or expires_on < today leads to refusal.
Matches rx.needs_pharmacist_check leading to review with reason 'prescriber_check'.
Last fill less than 14 days ago leads to refusal.
Account standing check requires good standing, declining if not met.
Declines if balance due is more than 25.00.
Declines if pause count is 2 or more, or if requested days exceed 30.
Opens an approval request with reason contract_lock if the line is under contract lock.
Declines if adding requested days to pause end exceeds 120 days from today.
Declines if requested days is fewer than 1 day.
The policy requires confirming caller identity via matching the billing postcode on the account, and making no change if it does not match or cannot be provided.
The policy states the account must be in good standing and suspended or closed accounts cannot exchange items.
The policy requires the order to be delivered, explicitly noting items from orders that are placed, shipped or cancelled cannot be exchanged.
The policy states final sale items cannot be exchanged and the new size must be different from the current size.
The policy requires the request to be within 30 days of the order date and items can only be exchanged once (declining if already exchanged).
The policy matches the condition req.amount > 30.00, precedence, and action create_review_request(order_id=order.order_id, reason='high_value').
The policy matches order.refunded_total + req.amount > order.total, checked in second position, leading to refusing with no refund action.
The policy requires the caller's postcode to match the account postcode, refusing/making no change if it does not match or cannot be given.
The policy states parcels out for delivery or already delivered cannot be rescheduled.
The policy specifies the new date must be no later than 14 days after today's date.
The policy requires the hire date given by the employee to match the hire date on file, otherwise making no change.
The policy requires the employee's status to be active, declining those who are not active.
The policy prohibits contractors from using this service to change work mode.
The policy states remote work is only allowed if the record shows remote eligibility; otherwise it is declined.
The policy states employees on an active performance plan can work only on site, declining hybrid or remote requests.
The policy requires the member's membership status to be good standing, and explicitly notes that members under review or closed cannot defer.
The policy requires the loan status to be current, noting loans that are late or paid off cannot be deferred.
The policy requires that the loan has used fewer than two deferrals (< 2, equivalent to not >= 2) and requested days not more than 60 (<= 60, equivalent to not > 60).
The policy instructs not to file if policy status is not active, matching R1.
The policy specifies earlier than the waiting period end date (with the end date itself covered), matching visit_date < waiting_period_ends.
The policy states more than 90 days before today's date, matching days_between(visit_date, today) > 90.
Identity check requires date of birth to match the owner on file; otherwise refused with no change.
Owner account status of hold refuses renewals.
Missing or unpassed emissions test refuses renewal.
Lien flag triggers review request with reason 'lien_check'.
Requests for more than two years are refused.
The policy states the membership must be active, refusing if paused or closed, matching mem.status != 'active'.
The policy requires the booking to be confirmed and refuses if cancelled, matching booking.status != 'confirmed'.
The policy refuses if the balance due is above zero, matching mem.balance_due > 0.
The policy refuses requests for less than one week or more than four weeks, matching req.weeks < 1 or req.weeks > 4.
The policy refuses if the booking has already been extended twice (at most twice in total), matching booking.extensions >= 2.
The policy directs opening an approval request with reason 'waitlist' if the space has a waiting list, matching space.has_waitlist -> outcome approval.
The policy requires verifying that the last four digits of the phone number match the account, refusing if they do not match or cannot be provided.
The policy states the order must be active, and cancelled or used orders cannot have their delivery changed.
The policy states mail delivery is not available for events fewer than 7 days away or already held.
Identity check requires date of birth matching the patient record, in first order, leading to making no change (refuse).
Checked second; appointment must have status booked or request is declined (refuse).
Checked third; reschedule count of 2 or more cannot be moved and is declined (refuse).
Checked fourth; visit type surgery triggers creating an approval request with reason surgery_move without changing the appointment.
The policy requires the account to be active and explicitly states that suspended or closed accounts cannot have a due date extended and must be declined.
The policy specifies that the bill must not be paid, can be extended at most twice in total, and each extension can add at most 14 days, declining requests for more than 14 days.
The policy requires the account status to be active, declining otherwise.
The policy requires no past-due balance, declining if any balance is owed.
The policy specifies starter subscriptions cannot add seats and must be declined.
The policy specifies requests above 50 seats must be declined.
The policy matches the condition and specifies opening an approval request with reason seat_cap.
The policy specifies declining when renewal is less than three days away or already passed.
